newsitem.title: USA: KCBT sets new annual trading volume record.
newsitem.headline: KCBT sets new annual trading volume record.

text.p: Year-to-date trading volume at the Kansas City Board of Trade has surpassed the previous highest annual level in the exchange's 140-year history, the KCBT said Monday.
As of 1200 CST Monday, 1996 year-to-date volume stood at an estimated 1,978,532 contracts. The previous annual exchange volume was set in 1985, when a total of 1,975,994 contracts changed hands.

The KCBT attributed the new record primarily to the volatile wheat market this spring, which prompted a surge in activity and prices over $7.00 per bushel for the first time in the exchange's history.
The KCBT also said the growth of Mini Value Line stock index futures and Western Natural Gas futures and options also helped set the new record.
